title: Context Manifest
description: Defines the precise context an agent receives for a task. Every field is intentional — no extraneous data.

agent_role.description: Agent role to dispatch for this task

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of manifest creation

context.description: Maximum input tokens for agent context

output.description: Maximum output tokens for agent response

objective.description: Clear, specific description of what the agent must accomplish

acceptance_criteria.description: Measurable criteria that define task completion

architect_spec.description: Path to the architect's specification file (if applicable)

target_files.description: Files the agent is authorized to create or modify

readable_files.description: Files the agent may read for context

reference_snippets.description: Targeted code snippets for pattern reference

project_conventions.description: Key project conventions the agent must follow

memory_refs.description: Paths to knowledge-broker reference docs in memory/

upstream_dependencies.description: Task IDs that must be complete before this task can start

downstream_consumers.description: Task IDs that will consume this task's output
